name: calc_card_involutions_rec
statement: (n : ℕ) : ((Finset.univ : Finset (Equiv.Perm (Fin (n + 2)))).filter (fun σ => σ * σ = 1)).card = ((Finset.univ : Finset (Equiv.Perm (Fin (n + 1)))).filter (fun σ => σ * σ = 1)).card + (n + 1) * ((Finset.univ : Finset (Equiv.Perm (Fin n))).filter (fun σ => σ * σ = 1)).card
closed: ∀ (n : ℕ), ((Finset.univ : Finset (Equiv.Perm (Fin (n + 2)))).filter (fun σ => σ * σ = 1)).card = ((Finset.univ : Finset (Equiv.Perm (Fin (n + 1)))).filter (fun σ => σ * σ = 1)).card + (n + 1) * ((Finset.univ : Finset (Equiv.Perm (Fin n))).filter (fun σ => σ * σ = 1)).card
informal: Involution numbers satisfy I(n+2) = I(n+1) + (n+1)·I(n) — split involutions of Fin (n+2) by whether the last point is fixed (I(n+1)) or swapped with one of n+1 others (remaining n points carry an involution).
type: ∀ (n : ℕ), {σ | σ * σ = 1}.card = {σ | σ * σ = 1}.card + (n + 1) * {σ | σ * σ = 1}.card
